answer: Agents mint identities along an attestation chain anchored to an origin node like an immutable pearl, while zero-knowledge proofs verify execution validity without leaking state. To prevent swarms from crossing the network like a river across a valley, identity staking costs grow exponentially per concurrent agent (O(2^n)). This exponential capital exhaustion leaves any Sybil swarm stranded on a barren knoll of unsustainable cost.
